items.label: Adjustable Back
items.value: The futon sofa bed has 3 positions adjustable, among 120°, 160° and 180°, which allows you to enjoy cozy vibe at home, no matter watch TV, play video games or take a nap

items.label: Convertible Sofa Bed
items.value: The folding futon set can be easily switched to a recliner sofa, or a guest bed, and the 2 removable arms can use as throw pillows, providing you certain support at sleep

items.label: Cozy Time
items.value: The futon couch is filled with high-resilient sponges, soft and supportive, covered by selected material, delivering relax and comfort experience just right. The 2 removable cup holders bring much convenient to get a drink when sitting in the sofa

items.label: Selected Material
items.value: Our sleeper futon sofa is made of good quality fabric, which is soft, smooth, and easy to maintain. The metal legs provide much stability with up to 500 lbs weight

items.label: Modern Futon
items.value: The sofa’s delicate design and colour, look simple but fashion, would suit the living room, bedroom, office, guest room and dorm

items.label: Quick Assembly
items.value: Only few steps, you can quickly finish the assemble work around 20 minutes. Kindly please note the 2 cup holders and 2 throw pillows are all packed under the sofa seat within the zipper. If you have any questions, please kindly let us know
